limitations: A small synthetic contract probe, not a general reliability ranking or failure-rate study
Only these types, null patterns and finite float values are tested; not every PPDS table/type
Binary columns are ordinary payload bytes, not Lance Blob v2 descriptors or external references
Truncation removes the final 8 Parquet bytes; missing Lance files are deleted only from temporary copies
No hosted access, concurrent writes, optional extensions, process crashes or power-loss recovery tested
